description: The v5 harness campaign first run on GLM-5.3-Flash (2026-11-16): six full v5 runs, each one change on top of an earlier arm, compared per unit against the model's L0 profile and the Claude Opus 5.5 reference ledger. Runbook: docs/MODEL_CAMPAIGN.md.

eta.basis: GLM-5.3-Flash arm A took 2.1 h at --jobs 4, B's wall-scaled turns est. +20%; thinking 2.3x per unit (C vs B)

arms.label: runner v2
arms.note: The merged default runner (G1-G4, G8, G11): the harness every later arm builds on.

arms.label: + wall-scaled turns
arms.note: One turn per 15 s of the unit's wall (medium 40, hard 60, xl 100): the L0 audit found most failures ended on the turn cap at 10-30% of their wall (G1).

arms.label: + thinking (wall x2, same turns)
arms.note: Per-request thinking on. --wall-scale 2 doubles the wall and keeps B's turns, so the contrast is thinking, not lost time (#186). The declared reasoning budget is the eval turn cap that bounds thinking (agents/runner.py _EVAL_TURN_TOKENS_THINKING), not 0.

arms.label: + diagnostics, edit hint, verify-done
arms.note: B's budget with push diagnostics (G14), the edit-not-rewrite hint (G13) and the test-before-done nudge (G9). Packs and escalation stay off.

arms.label: + packs, env block, wall warnings (+ thinking iff C > B)
arms.note: D plus the language packs v2 and the host pack (G19, G20; OPENBEAST_PACK_VARIANT=v2, since the variant defaults to the measured v1 pack), the first-turn environment block (G22) and wall-clock warnings (G23); thinking on, at wall x2, only if C beat B.

arms.label: B under --seed 1 (noise)
arms.note: A Spark server that gets no seed uses a fixed one, so every run is one deterministic draw. B again under another seed: its flips against B are the single-draw noise floor.
